policy.original_wording: Prefer original Taiwan-authored/curated vocabulary. Never convert Simplified corpora into Taiwan data.
policy.no_shortcuts: Script, zh-tw tags, dataset size, stars and source overlap do not establish editorial quality.
policy.ranking: Source inclusion and typing frequency are separate decisions.
policy.selection: Systematic source/category rules only; no per-name lists or benchmark tuning.
policy.legacy: Replace decisions freeze the exact existing release; this records migration debt, not approval of source quality.

sources.name: McBopomofo
sources.editorial: Maintained Taiwan input-method data with source readings and correction history.
sources.coverage: 171,708 readings in current compiled base.
sources.limitations: Original data can still contain uncommon readings; name-unit concatenation is not verified pronunciation.
sources.reason: Retain the Taiwan input-method foundation.

sources.name: Rudy / OSM Taiwan POI
sources.editorial: Locally maintained thematic mapping built on OSM contributions.
sources.coverage: Complete pinned normalized POI snapshot; existing sector/reading exclusions in rudy-manifest.
sources.limitations: Not all names have usable Mandarin readings; map presence is not typing frequency.
sources.reason: Preserve the high-quality geography source and separate ODbL pack.

sources.name: AOSP LatinIME English
sources.editorial: Upstream English keyboard lexicon; contractions retained.
sources.coverage: Current en_US corpus; existing spelling report records filters.
sources.limitations: English source, not evidence about Taiwan Chinese.
sources.reason: Retain English-specific source.

sources.name: ChhoeTaigi iTaigi
sources.editorial: Community contributions retain contributor IDs and original POJ fields.
sources.coverage: 19,046 source records in pinned dataset description; compiled counts in existing manifest.
sources.limitations: Contributor quality varies; Mandarin gloss length filter limits coverage.
sources.reason: Retain original POJ and source attribution.

sources.name: Taiwanese beginner vocabulary
sources.editorial: Digitized authored beginner vocabulary, retaining source variants.
sources.coverage: 5,429 source records; current short-expression import is narrower.
sources.limitations: Historical 1956 vocabulary is not a modern frequency sample.
sources.reason: Retain POJ; do not infer modern popularity.

sources.name: JMDICT
sources.editorial: Maintained Japanese dictionaries with reading/spelling relationships and source metadata.
sources.coverage: Common expressions for JMdict; names/works/professions for JMnedict.
sources.limitations: Common flags are not a complete frequency model. jmdict-simplified denotes a JSON format, not Simplified Chinese.
sources.reason: Retain Japanese-specific sources.

sources.name: JMNEDICT
sources.editorial: Maintained Japanese dictionaries with reading/spelling relationships and source metadata.
sources.coverage: Common expressions for JMdict; names/works/professions for JMnedict.
sources.limitations: Common flags are not a complete frequency model. jmdict-simplified denotes a JSON format, not Simplified Chinese.
sources.reason: Retain Japanese-specific sources.

sources.name: WanaKana
sources.editorial: Kana romanization library.
sources.coverage: Build-time aliases.
sources.limitations: Does not establish vocabulary quality.
sources.reason: Retain language tooling.

sources.name: CC-CEDICT legacy Taiwan filter
sources.editorial: Global dictionary; current importer reads Traditional headwords and Taiwan-marked definitions.
sources.coverage: Legacy optional usage vocabulary plus inferred name readings.
sources.limitations: A Taiwan mention and Traditional spelling do not establish locally natural usage.
sources.reason: Freeze existing contribution pending Taiwan-authored replacement.
sources.replacement: Replace usage vocabulary with locally authored lexicons; use Taiwan reading sources.

sources.name: Wikidata legacy cultural labels
sources.editorial: Global collaborative structured entity data.
sources.coverage: Legacy film/book/song queries are limited to 60 rows each.
sources.limitations: Locale fallback and citizenship gates distort wording and historical coverage.
sources.reason: Freeze existing contribution; use specialist authored catalogs for wording.
sources.replacement: Replace with cultural institutions and source-attested entity names.

sources.name: Wikipedia category-derived Taiwan pack
sources.editorial: Global article/category editing; Wikidata identity checks.
sources.coverage: 15,228 pages within depth two; 12,458 total Taiwan outputs in 0.6.4.
sources.limitations: Categories are not editorial quality; zh-tw labels are not proof of Taiwan authorship or usage.
sources.reason: Freeze current data; stop treating volume and locale tags as quality.
sources.replacement: Evaluate specialist Taiwan sources by sector before replacement.

sources.name: Legacy build-time OpenCC detector
sources.editorial: Script-variant detector only in 0.6.4 importer.
sources.coverage: No converted candidate text is produced by the final 0.6.4 detector.
sources.limitations: Detecting unchanged spelling does not validate Taiwanese wording.
sources.reason: Freeze until replacing the mixed-source import path.
sources.replacement: Remove detector when original Taiwan name sources replace mixed-script titles.

sources.name: Rime Luna / Essay / Prelude
sources.editorial: Rime-maintained Traditional lexicon; Taiwan glyph-variant filter is t2tw.
sources.coverage: Native phrase and incomplete-input decoding.
sources.limitations: Frequency distribution is not Taiwan-specific; rare exact readings and inversion cases remain in GLYPHS.md.
sources.reason: Retain frozen native behavior during source evaluation; replacement requires broad ranking evidence.
sources.replacement: Benchmark Taiwan-authored native lexicon/frequency replacements separately from add-ons.

sources.name: UD context training
sources.editorial: Wiki treebank, annotated/converted to UD; this does not itself mean script conversion.
sources.coverage: 3,997 Chinese and 12,544 English training sentences in current context report.
sources.limitations: Annotation licence differs from underlying text rights; Chinese genre is not everyday Taiwan conversation.
sources.reason: Freeze model; keep train/dev/test roles distinct.
sources.replacement: Evaluate Taiwan conversational sources and their underlying rights before context retraining.

sources.name: TaiCOL Taiwan species
sources.editorial: Literature-linked taxonomy curated by specialist contributors.
sources.coverage: Full v1.13 archive audited: 111,267 taxon rows, 45,616 distinct Chinese name fields.
sources.limitations: Many taxa lack Chinese labels or Mandarin readings; synonyms and accepted taxa must be distinguished. No popularity weights.
sources.reason: First candidate for nature-sector replacement.

sources.name: 如月的現代台灣華語補足典
sources.editorial: Authored observations of Taiwan Mandarin gaps; completed entries separate from Todo.
sources.coverage: 346 completed entries; 314 with Zhuyin in fetched revision.
sources.limitations: Small and topical; colloquial and dated senses occur. Not a general frequency corpus.
sources.reason: Good local usage supplement; audit parser and full/partial lookup before import.

sources.name: Taiwan.md
sources.editorial: Taiwan-oriented editorial project with AI-assisted production and review metadata.
sources.coverage: 1,110 topical article filenames; 104 stratified article samples inspected mechanically.
sources.limitations: 104 frozen topical samples: 90 lastHumanReview:false, 14 true; 28 curation:incubating. These are metadata signals, not an accuracy verdict. Essays and explanatory titles are not a ready lexicon or a conversational frequency corpus.
sources.reason: Pilot source discovery and essay evaluation; reviewed prose has a separate role from conversational tests or production vocabulary.

sources.name: CIP Indigenous community names
sources.editorial: Indigenous Peoples Council administrative community inventory with original romanization.
sources.coverage: 739 records, 708 distinct name fields, 0 missing romanizations.
sources.limitations: Administrative recognition is not all historical settlements. Duplicate names and two truncated-looking fields need source-level handling.
sources.reason: Strong identity/romanization candidate; preserve community names and scripts.

sources.name: BAMID music awards catalogs
sources.editorial: Official nomination and winner records; named people and works.
sources.coverage: 80 linked CSVs; 5,456 rows, 8 schemas, editions 1-35; 3,196 distinct nonempty work fields. Catalog freshness does not imply current award coverage.
sources.limitations: Award selection omits much everyday and independent culture; artists, credits and song/album fields need separation.
sources.reason: Candidate for musicians/works; awards do not become frequency weights.

sources.name: Taiwan Biographical Database
sources.editorial: Academic historical person authority project; guide documents relation export.
sources.coverage: Historical periods and bulk denominator not verified in this audit.
sources.limitations: Public browsing/export does not establish a reusable bulk-data licence.
sources.reason: Promising historical identity source; obtain a reusable snapshot and terms first.

sources.name: National Museum of Taiwan Literature databases
sources.editorial: Named specialist-authored literary entries and bibliographies.
sources.coverage: Authors, works and Japanese-era literature; whole inventory not downloaded.
sources.limitations: Source-specific reuse terms and bulk access unresolved; not a ready IME dictionary.
sources.reason: Prefer specialist names/works over broad category ancestry; establish dataset access first.

sources.name: National Cultural Memory Bank / Taiwan encyclopedia
sources.editorial: Institutional and community collections with source and rights metadata.
sources.coverage: Broad history/culture inventory; open API scope is narrower than the whole portal.
sources.limitations: Custom API requires a key; licences differ per object; image titles often do not name a lexical entity.
sources.reason: Evaluate compatible datasets individually, never scrape the whole portal into phrases.

sources.name: MOE / Moedict dictionary data
sources.editorial: Edited Taiwan dictionaries; revised and concise editions have different purposes.
sources.coverage: Large dictionary reference with original pronunciation fields.
sources.limitations: Historical/literary coverage is not modern frequency; ND text terms are not relicensed by a wrapper repository.
sources.reason: Use as a reference; establish permissible derivative use before adding an importer.

sources.name: UD English GUM evaluation
sources.editorial: Annotated multi-genre corpus with original document genre labels.
sources.coverage: Existing 1,285 sentence probes include 193 conversation and 60 essay rows.
sources.limitations: English only; genres vary in style and rights. Previously evaluated; not a fresh holdout. No production reuse approved here.
sources.reason: Reuse existing genre-separated regression evidence.

sources.name: Taiwanese source-attested paired output
sources.editorial: Explicit iTaigi/Taihoa POJ/HanLo pairs; preserve prior choices, extend through authored beginner vocabulary and existing familiarity policy.
sources.coverage: Existing POJ outputs with source-attested iTaigi/Taihoa alternatives; generated manifest records counts.
sources.limitations: Mandarin written occurrence ranks familiarity but does not veto attested beginner words. One example per complete pronunciation is not semantic disambiguation or community consensus.
sources.reason: Optional direct alternative output for existing Taiwanese candidates; does not change ranking or primary phonetic output.

sources.name: 台華線頂對照典 / Taihoa
sources.editorial: Taiwan-authored 鄭良偉 foundation, expanded and edited by 楊允言 and transcription/proofreading volunteers; original POJ/HanLo fields.
sources.coverage: 91,339 records at existing ChhoeTaigi pin. Use source-attested alternatives only for existing shipped phonetic outputs.
sources.limitations: Dictionary breadth is not typing frequency or spelling consensus. Homophones have multiple senses; canonical form is one pronunciation example. No guessed alternate-reading pairing.
sources.reason: Restore basic Taiwanese Han alternatives missing from iTaigi-only metadata.
